relationships.subject: Ac-KKK-NH2
relationships.evidence_quote: A series of experiments demonstrated a statistically significant (4.8 ± 0.5 (n = 25) vs. 6.5 ± 0.4 (n = 25)) decrease in the Zeff value of the NaV1.8 channel activation gating system after extracellular application of Ac-KKK-NH2 at 100 nM (Figure 6).

relationships.subject: Ac-KKK-NH2
relationships.evidence_quote: The blind docking with the Na<sub>V</sub>1.8 channel has made it possible to locate the Ac-KKK-NH<sub>2</sub> binding site on the extracellular side of the voltage-sensing domain VSD<sub>I</sub>.

key_findings: Ac-KKK-NH2 at 100 nM decreases NaV1.8 activation gating effective charge and is analgesic at spinal and supraspinal levels in the formalin test.
Docking places the tripeptide at the extracellular side of VSDI, contacting Asp151, Glu157 and Thr161.
